comment: He is one of the best professors you will ever take. At the beginning he might look scary but he is extremely helpful when you demonstrate your true interest and your hard work. He will ask you questions about the readings or will have pop quizzes. He is available literally 24/7 and will give you bonus points  for everything.

Volker is the man. He is funny and makes class interesting with his clever examples. Attendance is not mandatory although he gives really easy pop quizzes that you will regret missing. Homework and the paper isnt hard. Midterms can be difficult but he curves alot. Also lets you opt out of the final exam. Take him if you have to take Bstats

Volker is the man.  Funny, amusing, curves the tests like hell, and a good teacher.  Bstats sucks, but if I didn't take him I would likely have failed.  Great teacher, work hard and you'll be rewarded

Awesome professor, not the easiest but really clear and works hard to get students to understand.  The textbook is useless so go to class even though its not mandatory.He is very funny and gives loads of worked examples. Also walks around the library before tests to help students! overall: take him for anything if you want to actually learn.

Volker is the man. He's always available for help and he's really laid back. Tests are hard but he puts a phat curve on them. Attendance optional but Bstats is hard to teach yourself so your better off going

Great professor. Works hard to make sure everyone understands the material. Makes himself available outside of class(Even came to the library from 11pm-2am to look for and help students before the final. Homework sets are very helpful and he always provides a complete answer key afterwards to check. Really cool guy, take his class if possible.

He is awesome.makes bstas, which is the most boring subject actually interesting. Attendance is not necessary so have fun. Test are fairly simple if u do hw are actually study...definetely recommend for bstat. u wont regret it.

He actually teaches the material and anything on the tests is stuff you've seen before on homework or class examples. Not much HW but if you skip class you probably wont understand anything. He has lots of little ways to improve your grade (easy HW points), the option to exempt the final, and makes you laugh daily. Great professor, very helpful.

His test are really hard but does curve them.  I failed the first test by a lot and still managed to get a B+.  If you are struggling at all ask for help, he does anything he can to help you and make you understand.
pretty nice guy, really down to earth.  tries really hard to make sure you understand the material.  tests are not too bad.

Volker's test are hard, but he puts a HUGE curve on it. B.Stats is a hard subject in itself, but VOlker makes it easy to understand (after probability). Homework definitely helps you understand it. People who don't do well can only blame themselves, I did minimum work, and got a B in the class, I hardly went to class (not mandatory), or did hw.
